topicData.angle: Write from the specific facts and details in the source material provided.

postText:
36% of Americans think China is ahead on AI. Only 12% think the US is.

India isn't even in the question.

We're probably the biggest AI user base on the planet right now. Every second person on my feed is using something. Consumption is insane. But building? Totally different scene.

51% in that same survey said AI will widen the gap between rich and poor countries. More than half. And tbh I think they're right.

If you're only using the tools, someone else is capturing the value. The model, the data, the infrastructure. None of that is ours.

India has the users. Has the engineers. Has real problems worth solving. We're not short on any of that. So I genuinely don't get why the builder story hasn't caught up to the user story yet. Still trying to figure that out.

But if the gap is gonna widen, I'd rather be on the side making the thing than just running it.

Curious what's actually stopping more people from building here, not just using.

#TechTakes #Opinion #AIIndia
